evidence.quote:
Every new hire completes the Pallasine checklist in their first
week

observations.why: Universal completion mandate for a structured checklist appeals to conservation (order, stability of process) and competence (mastery through a defined sequence).

evidence.quote:
It replaced the
old wiki page last quarter.

observations.why: Framing the checklist as a replacement for a prior system appeals to conservation — keeping what works by updating the stable artifact rather than abandoning structure.
